prompt.project_info: A golden-window-light ethereal fashion close-up without public-figure likeness.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman with light freckles, natural rosy undertones, expressive eyes, softly pursed lips, and blonde hair in an effortless loose bun with wisps framing her face. She wears a minimalist black camisole with thin straps.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical close-up: she sends a flying kiss to camera with a gentle hand gesture. Frame creamy bokeh, sheer curtains, and sharp eyes; exclude text, logos, watermark, and celebrity likeness.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Golden sunlight through sheer white curtains creates soft highlights, glowing rim light, warm tones, gentle contrast, and soft shadows.
prompt.technical_specs: Sony A7R IV, 50mm f/1.4, low ISO, shallow depth, natural window light, 4K photorealistic editorial texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Fashion editorial close-up of an adult woman with delicate light-freckled porcelain complexion, natural rosy undertones, expressive eyes with subtle shimmer, soft lips gently pursed, blonde effortless loose bun with soft wisps, and minimalist black delicate camisole with thin straps. She sends a flying kiss toward the camera with an elegant hand gesture and gracefully curved fingers. Golden sunlight through sheer white curtains, soft highlights, glowing rim light, dreamy warm tones, creamy bokeh, shallow depth, sharp eyes, Sony A7R IV, 50mm f/1.4, low ISO, cinematic warm highlights, gentle contrast, soft shadows, 4K photorealistic high-end fashion photography. Never use a celebrity or public-figure likeness.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, celebrity or public-figure likeness, sexualized pose, body-part emphasis, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, readable text, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No reference asset is required. If an approved adult identity reference is attached, preserve face, facial structure, and likeness without using a celebrity. Preserve black camisole, flying-kiss gesture, loose bun, sheer curtains, and golden window-light direction; other details may be replaced.
